definitions.explanation: So wrong, offensive, or harmful that it cannot be forgiven or overlooked.

examples.japanese: {許|ゆる}し{難|がた}い⟦{行為|こうい}→行為：10021_koui⟧だ。
⟦{仲間|なかま}→仲間：03498_nakama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{裏切|うらぎ}る→裏切る：02011_uragiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{許|ゆる}し{難|がた}い。

⟦{弱|よわ}い→弱い：00825_yowai⟧⟦{立場|たちば}→立場：03403_tachiba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧だまして⟦{金|かね}→金：02618_kane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{奪|うば}う→奪う：01895_ubau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{許|ゆる}し{難|がた}い⟦{罪|つみ}→罪：03532_tsumi⟧だ。
examples.english: Deceiving people in a vulnerable position to take their money is an inexcusable crime.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{許|ゆる}す→許す：02325_yurusu⟧ (to forgive) + the suffix ～⟦{難|がた}い→難い：17198_gatai⟧ (hard to ~). It expresses strong moral condemnation and has a formal, somewhat literary tone.

USAGE:
The ～⟦{難|がた}い→難い：17198_gatai⟧ pattern attaches to verb stems to mean "difficult to ~": ⟦{理解|りかい}→理解：03674_rikai⟧し⟦{難|がた}い→難い：17198_gatai⟧ (hard to understand), ⟦{信|しん}じ{難|がた}い→信じ難い：19679_shinjigatai⟧ (hard to believe). {許|ゆる}し{難|がた}い is stronger and more formal than ⟦{許|ゆる}せない→許す：02325_yurusu⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {許|ゆる}し{難|がた}い⟦{行為|こうい}→行為：10021_koui⟧: an unforgivable act
- {許|ゆる}し{難|がた}い⟦{罪|つみ}→罪：03532_tsumi⟧: an inexcusable crime

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{許|ゆる}せない→許す：02325_yurusu⟧: unforgivable — more colloquial and emotional
- ⟦{耐|た}え{難|がた}い→耐え難い：19680_taegatai⟧: unbearable; hard to endure
